title: Debugging
summary: Step through a program, trace what it does, watch the network and the disk.
consent: These tools can read any process's memory and every packet on the box. Install them only while you need them: they are removed again after the time you choose.
notes: perf is built for Debian's kernel; on a vendor kernel parts of it may not work (on the Lyra's 6.1 it reports 6.12 and runs).
bpftrace and the bcc tools need the kernel's BPF support. On the Lyra (32-bit, vendor kernel 6.1) bpftrace's programs pass the verifier but fail to load: it does not work there (2026-10-06).
Core dumps are collected while the kit is installed (systemd-coredump); its other services stay stopped.
